utility-class.description: Tailwind utility class generated from the theme

theme-token.description: A CSS custom property declared in @theme, e.g. --color-brand, which generates matching utilities.

layer.description: One of Tailwind's cascade layers — theme, base, components, utilities — controlling precedence.

spacing-scale.description: The numeric scale behind padding, margin, gap, width and height. 1 unit = 0.25rem by default.

color-scale.description: A named hue with a 50-950 shade, e.g. slate-700. v4 tokens are CSS custom properties.

breakpoint.description: A min-width variant prefix: sm, md, lg, xl, 2xl. Mobile-first, so an unprefixed utility applies at every size.

arbitrary-value.description: A one-off value in square brackets, e.g. w-[37px] or bg-[#1da1f2]. Underscores stand in for spaces.

arbitrary-property.description: A whole declaration in brackets, e.g. [mask-type:luminance], for properties with no utility.

variant.description: A conditional prefix such as hover:, focus-visible:, dark:, group-hover:, data-[state=open]:. Variants stack left to right.

modifier.description: A slash suffix altering a utility, e.g. bg-black/50 for opacity or text-sm/6 for line-height.

negative-value.description: A leading hyphen inverts a scale value, as in -mt-4.

important-modifier.description: A trailing ! adds !important, e.g. text-red-500!  (v4; v3 used a leading !).

container-query.description: @container-based variants such as @sm: and @max-md:, matching the nearest container rather than the viewport.
